continuous_text.title: My Body Song
continuous_text.content:
Do you have two ears?
Do you have one mouth?
Do you have two eyes?
Yes, I do. Yes, I do.

I have ten fingers.
I have ten toes.
I have two feet
And one big nose!

And do you have long legs?
And do you have short hair?
And do you have small hands?
I sing my body song, my body song,
I sing my body song again!

continuous_text.title: Lost Teddy Bear
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1:
Tim: Do you have a teddy bear?
Clerk: I don't know. Let's see.
Patrick: Bobo...
Frame 2:
Clerk: Is this your teddy bear?
Tim: No. My teddy bear has small ears.
Frame 3:
Clerk: Is this your teddy bear?
Tim: No. My teddy bear has short legs.
Frame 4:
Clerk: Is this your teddy bear?
Tim: No, my teddy bear is brown.
Frame 5:
Clerk: Brown? Oh! Does he have one eye?
Tim: Yes, he does! Bobo has one eye!
Frame 6:
Clerk: Aha! Is this Bobo?
Patrick: Yes, it is! Bobo!
Tim: Thank you!
continuous_text.notes: Frames 1-4 on p. 44; frames 5-6 on p. 45; track 77

continuous_text.content:
1 I have two eyes. I see with my eyes. Look! I see a picture.

4 I have two ears. I hear with my ears. Listen! I hear a guitar.

continuous_text.title: Keep Clean
continuous_text.content:
1 Every day
Before I eat
And after I play,
I wash my hands.

2 With a lot of soap
It's easy, you see.
Rinse with water
Just like me.

3 Dry them well and
Sing this song.
Keep your hands clean
All day long!
